The '''Long Drink''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the city of [[Morjanssik]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. [[Kruluk]] worked there as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]. A fight occurred there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thugs led by [[Logor]] working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
